Shield: functionally short for "While I am a defender, I have +X [M]."

Temporary: functionally short for "At the start of this permanent's controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring, kill this."
Vision: functionally short for "When this is played, [Predict]."

Repeat: functionally short for "You may pay [Cost] as an additional cost as you play this. If you do, execute the instructions of this chain item one additional time during resolution."

Level: functionally short for "While you have [N] or more XP, this card gains '[Text]'."
